Subject: MAP & evaluation plan — initial proposal

Hi Lena —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Per our discussion, I put together a draft mutual action plan (attached) and an evaluation timeline so Atlas can validate latency/cost while our teams run a pilot. High level proposal:

- Evaluation window: 8 weeks (functional + performance + integration).
- Pilot commit structure: 3-month committed ramp following evaluation.
  - Month 0 (eval): sandbox usage, no committed charge.
  - Month 1 (paid start): 100M tokens committed / month (TPM = tokens per month).
  - Month 2: 250M tokens committed.
  - Month 3+: target steady state 500M tokens/month.
- Pricing: tiered unit price with a ramped discount tied to commit band. Example attached in the MAP.
- Milestones & gating: integration sign-off, P0 latency validation (<150ms p95 for text gen), security checklist complete (KMS + audit log confirmation).

Two asks from you to keep things moving:
1) Confirm target steady-state TPM and whether your team can commit to the proposed schedule above (or propose alternate ramp).
2) Share procurement contact to surface commercial/legal items early.

I attached MAP_v1 (draft) — I’ll follow up with a pricing worksheet after we align on the ramp. Marissa from SE will help size the infra and confirm perf expectations; Monica (legal) will triage any contract constraints.

Thanks,
Karthik
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 415-555-0123

Appreciate the clear outline. A couple of quick notes from my side:

- The steady-state target of 500M TPM looks reasonable long-term, but leadership is concerned about the front-loaded ramp (100M -> 250M -> 500M in three months). Could we smooth it? Would prefer a softer start (150M) and extend ramp to 6 months.
- Procurement: please include our procurement contact on the thread (procurement@atlashealth.com). They will need the detailed pricing table and commercial terms (SLA, data retention, breach notification timelines).
- Also confirm whether the committed tokens are monthly caps or true consumption-based commitments (i.e., do unused tokens credit forward?).

I'll review the MAP PDF and loop in our engineering lead separately for perf questions.

Best,

Lena / Procurement team —

Thanks for the quick feedback. A few clarifications and updated options below; attached is MAP_v2 and a draft SOW for scope.

Definitions: TPM = tokens per month (committed). Unused committed tokens: we offer a 3-month carry-forward credit on committed plans (can be applied to future months within the 12-month term) OR cash credit at quarter close if we agree on an early true-up.

Options for ramp structure (pick one; we can hybridize):
A) Aggressive ramp (original): 100M -> 250M -> 500M (3 months). Greater discounts available (up to 22% effective) if committed through month 12.
B) Smooth ramp (recommended by vendor): 150M -> 200M -> 300M -> 400M -> 500M (over 5 months). Slightly lower max discount but lower financial risk for Atlas in Q1.
C) Stepped ramp + credits: Start 120M first paid month, then monthly step increases; if you hit agreed TPM milestones each month we apply milestone credits (e.g., $X credit applied to next invoice).

Commercial flex points we can negotiate: initial term length (6 vs 12 months), carry-forward window, milestone credit amounts, and SLA credit thresholds.

Action items for atlas procurement to speed contracting:
- Confirm target option (A/B/C) and whether the commit is monthly cap or true consumption.
- If you want carry-forward credits, indicate preference for 3-month or end-of-term true-up.

Attachments: MAP_v2.pdf, SOW-draft.docx

Marissa — can you validate performance SLAs in MAP_v2 vs the perf targets Lena mentioned? Monica — please review SOW-draft for any non-standard clause we should expect.

Regards,
Karthik

Thanks — attached is the pricing_sheet.csv with per-token breakouts and three commercial scenarios matched to the ramp options we discussed. Summary:

  - 100M–300M: $0.00065/token
  - 300M–600M: $0.00050/token
- Example first 6 months invoices (see attached) for Smooth Ramp (Option B): Month1=150M, Month2=200M, Month3=300M, Month4=400M, Month5=450M, Month6=500M.
- Unused committed tokens: 3-month carry-forward OR end-of-term true-up (your choice).
- Security: SOC 2 Type II attestation attached link (https://drive.redwood.ai/security/soc2-2025.pdf). KMS: customer managed key (BYOK) support for private deployments; hosted: KMS in tenant-backed HSM with 90-day key rotation; audit logs retained 12 months by default (longer retention available as add-on).

Commercial incentives: If Atlas meets agreed monthly TPM milestones, we apply a milestone credit equal to 3% of that month’s invoice (applied to next invoice). If you sign a 12‑month term at >300M steady-state, we can increase max effective discount to 25% and offer a one-time onboarding credit.
